name: PlayStation
description: PS4 and PS5 account library, with optional played games and PS3/PS Vita trophy history. History does not prove ownership. Console games cannot launch on this PC.

settings.label: Sony session token (NPSSO)
settings.help: Sign in at playstation.com, then open the setup link in the same browser and copy the npsso value. Save to connect. Treat it like a password. Remove the saved token to disconnect; imported games remain.

settings.label: Include played games
settings.help: Adds PS4/PS5 played history and available playtime, including disc, trial and subscription games. Does not prove a purchase or current access.

settings.label: Include PS3 and PS Vita trophy history
settings.help: Adds trophy sets exclusive to PS3/PS Vita. Trophy sync dates are not last-played dates. Shared PS4/PS5 sets are excluded to avoid duplicate games.
